property_summary: For any caller/target/asset, withdrawGovernanceAsset must revert (ok == false) whenever the stored pending decision for that caller/target has unlockTime strictly in the future, because the reference requires unlockTime < block.timestamp; the buggy version inverts the comparison so it succeeds early, making ok true where the reference reverts.
change_summary: Replace the `< block.timestamp` check in the withdraw require with `> block.timestamp`, so withdrawal succeeds only before the unlock time instead of after it.
